summary: Iteration 35 tested 5 items: (1) MOCKED→LIVE banner switch on /admin/financials, (2) POST /api/admin/reviews/scan-books-invoices manual trigger, (3) rate-limit 429 body shape with retry_after_seconds, (4) Project/Review _en fields via PATCH, (5) Bulk AI vertaal buttons on Portfolio & Reviews, 429 cooldown chip on AiTranslateButton, and public EN localization. Backend pytest: 6/6 pass (test_iteration35.py). Frontend Playwright: all flows verified. GET /api/admin/financials returns zoho_books.mocked=false; the emerald 'Zoho Books LIVE' banner (data-testid=financials-live-banner) renders and the amber 'financials-mocked-banner' is absent. POST /api/admin/reviews/scan-books-invoices returned {scanned:0, invited:0, skipped:0, errors:[]} (no paid invoices in last 90 days — expected per iter context) and the second call was idempotent. With ai_translate_limit_per_minute=1 and one slot consumed, subsequent /api/admin/ai/translate returned 429 with detail={message, message_en, retry_after_seconds:42, limit:1} and Retry-After header. PATCH /api/projects/{id} accepts title_en+description_en and PATCH /api/reviews/{id} accepts quote_en; both persist and echo via GET. Portfolio page shows violet 'Bulk AI translate' button (data-testid=cms-projects-bulk-translate) with badge count 6, clicking opens modal (cms-projects-bulk-translate-modal) with Start button. Reviews page shows the same button (cms-reviews-bulk-translate) with badge count 1, plus a 'Scan Books nu' button. Clicking cms-title-translate on Portfolio while rate-limit was armed (limit=1, one prior hit) replaced the button with a red '17s' chip at data-testid=cms-title-translate-cooldown that decremented to '15s' after ~2.2s (ticks down every second, ~1s/step). Public site with pb_lang=en shows p.title_en / p.description_en on Home and /portfolio.

ui_bugs.issue: Hard-coded amber 'mocked' badge at line 191 next to the 'Zoho Books' section heading — it is rendered unconditionally, so even when zoho_books.mocked===false (Books is LIVE) the section still shows 'MOCKED'. This contradicts the emerald 'Zoho Books LIVE' banner shown just above. The badge should be gated on `zoho?.mocked` (mirror line 119) — swap for a green 'live' pill when mocked===false or hide entirely.

action_items: Fix hard-coded 'mocked' badge inside the Zoho Books summary card (AdminFinancials.jsx line 191) — make it conditional on data.zoho_books.mocked (show emerald 'live' when false).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit is now MongoDB-persistent (ai_translate_hits) — good. However there is no TTL index on ai_translate_hits.ts so rows accumulate forever. Consider a TTL index that expires docs after ~120s (2× window) to keep the collection bounded.

_books_autopilot_loop starts unconditionally via asyncio.create_task in on_startup. If Zoho Books creds are missing, _books_autopilot_scan_once returns silently every 15 min — fine, but this also means multiple pod replicas will all scan the same invoices concurrently. Not a real bug because send_manual_invite dedupes on review_invites.project_id, but consider a simple advisory lock (find_one_and_update on a 'locks' doc with expiry) to avoid duplicate Zoho API calls.

AdminFinancials.jsx still has the amber MOCKED pill hard-coded in the Zoho Books card body (line 191). The top banner is correctly gated; the in-card badge is not — please DRY these two into a single derived boolean.

AiTranslateButton computes cooldownRemaining every render using Math.ceil((cooldownUntil - Date.now())/1000). At the very first render right after 429, if retry_after_seconds=42 arrived slightly late the chip may briefly flash 'NaN' — consider defaulting to (detail?.retry_after_seconds ?? 60) before setState.

BulkTranslateButton retries once on 429. If the admin has thousands of items and hits multiple 429s per minute, the modal will freeze on a single 'waiting' state. Consider surfacing 'waiting Xs before next item' text to keep the progress-bar honest.
seed_data_creation: PATCHed one existing project (Havenbedrijf — BI Dashboards, id=73776f22-fc85-4ea3-8a95-43174ffb9a2f) with title='Test NL Iter35', title_en='Test EN Iter35', description_en='Description EN' for public EN localization verification. After tests, title was restored to 'Havenbedrijf — BI Dashboards' and title_en/description_en cleared. Rate-limit setting was toggled to 1 during cooldown-chip test and restored to 30 at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter35 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration35.py. Test #3 (test_rate_limit_429_retry_after_shape) mutates site_settings.ai_translate_limit_per_minute to 3 and restores 30 at the end — if killed mid-run the setting stays at 3 (bulk-translate buttons will 429 quickly). Zoho Books is LIVE (mocked=false confirmed via curl + UI banner) but the org has 0 paid invoices in the last 90 days, so scan-books-invoices returns 0/0/0. AiTranslateButton cooldown chip is data-testid `${testid}-cooldown` — proven working with cms-title-translate-cooldown at 17s→15s. The public NL fallback path could not be fully verified from a logged-in admin session because LanguageContext syncs pb_lang from the user's preferred_lang on the backend; test the NL fallback from an incognito/anonymous browser context.
rca of the issue: AdminFinancials Zoho Books card badge — the developer added the LIVE-vs-MOCKED conditional at the top-of-page banner (lines 119 and 129 correctly gated on data?.zoho_books?.mocked), but forgot to update the pre-existing decorative 'mocked' pill inside the Zoho Books section header (line 191). Because the pill was hard-coded before this iteration, it silently stayed. Fix: replace `mocked` with `{zoho?.mocked ? mocked : live}`.
